ddl.where: "outputImageDeletedAt" IS NULL AND "outputImage" <> '' AND ("status" = 'succeeded' OR "status" IS NULL)
ddl.name: systemPrompt_image_retention_idx

ddl.value: ("estimated_units" IS NULL OR "estimated_units" >= 0) AND ("confirmed_units" IS NULL OR "confirmed_units" >= 0)
ddl.name: account_charge_amount_check

ddl.value: ("state" = 'confirmed') = ("confirmed_units" IS NOT NULL AND "confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: account_charge_confirmation_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'running' AND "lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" <> 'running' AND "lease_owner" IS NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: background_removal_lease_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'succeeded' AND "output_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "output_url" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" <> 'succeeded' AND "output_asset_id" IS NULL AND "output_url" IS NULL)
ddl.name: background_removal_output_check
